description: Refurbishment of the existing dwelling house and remodelling the existing (non-historic) rear extension in order to improve its thermal performance and improve living in the house. Removal of the existing air vents on the front elevation; replacement of all windows on the rear elevation with double glazed units and replacement of dormer windows only on the front elevation with double glazed units. Roof repairs to leaking roof with like for like materials.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>No permission is granted for any new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents, ductwork, grilles, aerials, meter boxes, security alarms, lighting, cameras or other appurtenances fixed to any external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved. All new external rainwater goods and soil pipes shall be of cast metal, painted black.<br><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify;">﻿﻿<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish, and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.</span></p><div><span id="m_6445723707789594282gmail-docs-internal-guid-b9018b6e-7fff-1142-7a09-c6a2d44f540e"><p dir="ltr" style="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify; line-height: 1.38;"><span style="font-size: 10px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><span style="font-size: 14px;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building</span>.</span></p></span></div>
